mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_tour_base (base_name, operation_unit, address, latitude, longitude, legal_representative, unified_social_credit_code, qualification_cert, feature_desc, business_status, contact_person, contact_phone, create_time, update_time, user_id) VALUES (#{baseName}, #{operationUnit}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{legalRepresentative}, #{unifiedSocialCreditCode}, #{qualificationCert}, #{featureDesc}, #{businessStatus}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT stb.*, u.username as user_name FROM study_tour_base stb LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON stb.user_id = u.id WHERE stb.id = #{id}
SELECT stb.*, u.username as user_name FROM study_tour_base stb LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON stb.user_id = u.id ORDER BY stb.create_time DESC
